title: Finance Project Manager and Business Analyst (AM)
description:
**Job Description – FSO ISPL**
 About BNP Paribas Group:
   

  

 BNP Paribas Group is a leading European bank with a strong global footprint across 72 markets and more than 202,000 employees. The Group provides corporates, institutional and private investors with product and service solutions tailored to their specific needs. It offers a wide range of financial services covering corporate \& institutional banking, wealth management, asset management, insurance, as well as retail banking and consumer financing through strategic partnerships.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas Group, a leading bank in Europe with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Mumbai, Chennai and Bengaluru, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. We partner various business lines of BNP Paribas such as Corporate and Institutional Banking, Wealth Management, Retail Banking through three verticals \- Information Technology, Operations and Finance Shared Services.
   

  

**About Business Line/ Function**
 The Finance Solutions Office (FSO) in ISPL is in\-charge of providing the below services worldwide:
   

  

* Steer the end\-to\-end implementation of Finance projects by responding to Business Line and F\&S requirements in a timely manner.
* Implement and maintain a harmonized Finance operating model across the Group with a particular focus on the roll\-out of One Financial System (OFS), cornerstone of the F\&S strategy


 Within the Finance Solutions Office, the Finance implementation projects (FIP) team is expected to:
   

  

* Ensure the end\-to\-end implementation of business and regulatory projects, aligned with the F\&S function’s strategy
* Define and parameterize accounting and reporting rules, according to the tool standards designed and maintained by FRESH
* Deliver projects launched under Regional/Local Sponsorship


**Job Title**
 Project Manager \& Business Analyst
   

  

**Date**
 July 2026
   

  

**Department**
 APAC Finance Implementation Projects (FIP – FSO, ISPL)
   

  

 Location:
   

  

**Mumbai, India**
**Business Line / Function**
 Finance Solutions office, Financial Shared Services
   

  

**Reports To**
 (Direct)
   

  

 Manager of Finance Implementation projects, FSO ISPL
   

  

**Grade**
 (if applicable)
   

  

**Number Of Direct Reports**
 N/A
   

  

**Directorship / Registration**
 N/A
   

  

 Position Purpose
   

  

 The Finance Implementation Projects (FIP) is in charge to drive and deliver the end\-to\-end regulatory and business projects implementation. The main mission is to integrate in Finance systems business processes and regulatory requirements, in accordance with Norms \& Standards, to embrace all streams of Reporting (Financial Accounting, Management Accounting, Credit Risk, and Liquidity). The APAC FIP team is part of the global FIP organization who is responsible for all accounting projects in APAC region.
   

  

 Mission statement
   

  

* Ensure the end\-to\-end implementation of the Business and Regulatory projects, in full alignment with Finance strategy.
* Respond to the various businesses and reporting requirements (Financial Accounting, Management Accounting, Credit Risk, Liquidity etc.) in a timely manner.
* Source and transform raw data and enable a good quality of reporting.
* Ensure a consistent approach of the Finance solutions across the region and align to Group standard.


 Role and responsibility
   

  

* Lead and drive the ledger transformation project in Finance in the context of ever changing business \& regulatory reporting requirements.
* Ensure consistency of Finance systems/reports across the APAC region, in adherence to the Group's standard.
* Provide efficient support to Finance teams in daily production tasks, whenever required
* Act as a bridge between request and the delivery of solution
* Major projects involve:
* Build or automate the accounting interface between operating systems and accounting core ledger systems
* Support new business and new products initiatives
* Support new regulatory requirements
* System upgrades and migrations


 Our values
   

  

* We are keen to understand our clients and serve our clients better.
* Focus on time\-to\-market and delivery to address business’s needs.
* Emphasize collaboration between teams to deliver solutions in the bank’s best interest.
* We believe there are always solutions.

* Acting as a Business Analyst (70%)
* Understand the project objective and ensure all user requirements are properly captured
* Carry out feasibility study, assess potential impact and define target operating model
* Explain the user requirements to IT for IT development
* Define the appropriate testing strategy according to the nature of the project
* Design test cases and ensure adequate testing is performed
* Validate testing result by performing detailed checking of accounting entries and/ or reports and secure UAT sign\-off
* Acting as a Project Manager (30%)
* Drive and manage all stages in project life cycle, from project initialization to project closure
* Develop project scope documentation, project plans and project schedules
* Continuously coordinate with IT and other finance users
* Undertake risk analysis and proactively identify mitigating solutions
* Timely track the progress of projects against agreed timeline and budget
* Arrange smooth go\-live implementation and provide post go\-live support
* Present project status regularly to senior management
* Build and maintain a trusted relationship with all project stakeholders across different functions (PMO, IT, finance users, operation teams)
* Provide support in case of production incidents, including root cause identification and proposing solutions to resolve the issue in a timely manner


 Contributing Responsibilities
   

  

* Identify areas of improvement; streamline the existing processes for efficiency
* Support team\-head to monitor the budget and share progress updates


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**

* Adequate knowledge of accounting treatment (especially on financial instruments) under IFRS
* Knowledge on front\-to\-back operation and financial products would be an advantage
* Proven ability in project delivery
* Good command of written and spoken English
* PC skills such as MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SQL


 Behavioral Competencies
   

  

* Excited about driving change
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work in multicultural environment, as the role needs to deal with different stakeholders across APAC regions
* Self\-driven and able to work independently
* Maintains an open‑ended curiosity that transcends traditional constraints
* Attention to detail
* Able to work under stress
* Strong problem solving and logical thinking skill
* Ability to multi\-task
* Team player


**Specific Qualifications (if Required)**
* Accounting and/or finance project related experience and/or Experience on financial reporting processes (7\+ years)
* CA/CPA/ACCA preferred, but not mandatory
* Experience in project management and PMP qualification preferred, but not necessary

title: Risk Analytics - Product Analyst - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \- Delivery Excellence Senior position**
 Within last decade, cost of delivery and Delivery excellence has become the most critical factors to run successful and popular businesses spread around the globe. To support such a dynamic and fast paced IT transformation industry, we are using various cutting\-edge Delivery Excellence models and tools with relentless focus on automation to offer best in class and tailor\-made solutions to our clients.
   

  

 As a part of our global team you will be part of GDS projects as Delivery Excellence management professional. You will be involved in working on challenging problems and creating next generation delivery excellence platforms.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Are you a detail driven professional with a passion for translating business needs into impactful product experiences? Do you thrive at the intersection of people, process, and technology? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our Product team and help shape solutions that deliver real value to our clients and users.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll serve as a critical bridge between the business stakeholders and the development and engineering teams. Your work will influence how ideas become features, how features become products, and how products deliver meaningful outcomes in a fast paced, evolving environment.
   

  

 As a key member of the Product team, you will play a hands on role in defining business requirements, crafting user stories, and ensuring that technical execution aligns seamlessly with business objectives. You will lead user acceptance testing (UAT), drive iterative testing cycles, validate enhancements, and ensure that issues or defects are accurately identified, tracked, and resolved. Your keen eye for detail and strong communication skills will help ensure that every release meets the highest standards of quality and functionality.
   

  

 This is a client facing and user centric role where you will engage with stakeholders, address queries, clarify requirements, and ensure that feedback is incorporated into continuous product improvements. You’ll gain a deep understanding of real world user behaviors, business processes, and product journeys—making this the perfect place to grow as a product focused business professional while driving meaningful impact across the product lifecycle.
   

  

 If you’re energized by the opportunity to influence product development end to end, collaborate with cross functional teams, and help bring scalable, user friendly solutions to life, this role provides the platform for you to make a lasting difference.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, ensuring alignment across stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by testing the defined test cases, validating functionality, and ensuring readiness for release.
* Support in iterative testing cycles, identifying defects, documenting issues, validating fixes, and performing regression testing as needed.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Serve as one of the primary liaison between business teams and engineering, providing clarifications, resolving requirement gaps, and ensuring shared understanding throughout the product lifecycle.
* Review and validate bug fixes, ensuring that resolved issues meet expected outcomes before closure.
* Engage with clients and end users, addressing queries, troubleshooting issues, and gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
* Support product rollout activities, including release planning, communication, and training support where required.
* Monitor product performance post release, identify enhancement opportunities, and contribute to backlog prioritization.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation including requirement specifications, UAT plans, test results, and user feedback logs.
* Support product strategy, roadmap planning, and end\-to\-end product lifecycle management for Internal Controls and Audit solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders across business, risk, audit, and technology teams to gather requirements and drive product adoption.
* Own MIS, reporting, KPI tracking, and executive dashboards to measure product performance and business outcomes.
* Analyse large datasets to derive insights, identify control gaps, and support decision\-making.
* Drive product implementation, rollout, user onboarding, and change management initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define functional requirements and prioritise product backlogs.
* Identify automation and AI opportunities to enhance audit and internal control processes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Risk Assessment – Assessment of internal processes to identify findings, vulnerabilities, and control gaps/deviations identified across applications and infrastructure.
* Control Monitoring / Testing \- Understanding of controls around Business processes, ITGC, Cyber, Data protection and privacy to perform testing of design and operational effectiveness of controls.
* Ability to create process documentation.
* Ability to understand business problems in Risk/Finance and contribute to translating them into solution or product requirements.
* Exposure (through projects or roles) to Risk, Finance, Supply Chain Operations (SCO), or related business functions preferred.
* Demonstrates interest in AI/analytics\-driven Risk solutions and their business applications.
* Agentic AI architecture\- Design agentic AI system architectures and define associated technical guardrails.
* Functional understanding of foundation models (LLMs) and associated risks. Awareness of the AI deployment lifecycle
* Control Automation – Identify automation opportunities using analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
* Basic exposure to Presales, solutioning, proposal support, or client presentations is a plus.
* Interest in working in tech\-enabled or AI\-led Risk products/solutions environment.
* Ability to support senior team members in product development, go\-to\-market efforts, and client engagements.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, global delivery environment with distributed teams.
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.
* Open to hiring across locations, aligned with EY’s Global Delivery Services (GDS) model.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Overall 3\-6 years of experience in Risk Advisory (preferably Internal Controls) experience with Big 4 or comparable professional services environment
* CA or Master’s degree in Business Administration or Risk management
* Good to have certifications – CISA, CISM, CIA, AIGP, ISO 42001, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant)
* Any 1 hard tech skill is a must – Either Python or Databricks Or full stack or AI
* Product Management experience with demonstrated ownership of delivering business solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Experience in reporting, MIS, analytics, and data\-driven decision making.
* Hands\-on experience in product implementation and deployment.
* Domain expertise in Internal Controls, Risk, Compliance, or Audit (mandatory).


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 250\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Business Intelligence Specialist
description:
We are seeking a Insights \& Analytics Lead (Business Intelligence) for a Series A funded Wellness Brand.
 



  





**Job Profile** 




 Your work will typically move through: Business Question \> Data \> Analysis \> Insight \> Decision \> Outcome.
 



 Knowing the difference between Fact, Inference, Hypothesis, and Unknown will be an important part of the job.
 



 Solve ambiguous business problems.\*\* Take loosely defined questions and structure them into analytical problems that can actually be investigated.
 



 Diagnose performance. Identify the underlying drivers behind important business movements rather than simply reporting the movement.
 



 Generate insights. Find patterns, relationships, exceptions, and opportunities that are not obvious from standard reporting.
 



 Challenge assumptions. Test prevailing explanations rather than accepting the first plausible narrative, including your own.
 



 Create a common fact base. Help leadership distinguish between what we know, what we believe, and what we still need to find out.
 



 Translate analysis into business language. Turn complex analysis into concise conclusions that senior leaders can understand and act upon.
 



 Support important decisions. As you build context and credibility, increasingly contribute to recommendations, experiments, and decision\-making.
 



 Build analytical systems. Develop reusable frameworks and diagnostic approaches so the organisation becomes progressively less dependent on individual intuition.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 Any Post Graduate
 



 5\-10 Years of experience
 



 Must have proven experience solving unusually difficult analytical problems
 



 You could come from Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Strategy, Consulting, Business Intelligence, Growth, Product, Marketing Analytics, Operations, Revenue Management, Corporate Strategy, Finance, Founder or Chief of Staff roles, or other analytically intensive functions.
 



 You could have worked in Consumer, Technology, SaaS, E\-commerce, Q\-commerce, Fintech, Edtech, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing, Consulting, or something completely different.
 



 Industry experience is not a prerequisite. If you are a strong analytical thinker, we expect you to learn a new business.
 



 What we need:
 



 Analytical reasoning\- You can take a messy problem, break it down, and determine what needs to be understood.
 



 Data fluency\- You are comfortable working directly with data and can independently investigate a problem using tools such as Excel/Sheets, SQL, BI tools, or equivalent. You do not need to be a data engineer. You do need to be able to go behind a dashboard when the question requires it.
 



 Business judgment\- You understand that analysis is valuable only when it improves understanding or decisions. You naturally ask: “So what?”
 



 Intellectual independence\- You are willing to challenge an attractive explanation when the evidence does not support it.

 Job Description
   

  

 Primary Role.
   

  

 Model risk relates to the risk of inaccurate assessment of underlying risks arising from inappropriate model development, calibration weaknesses or incorrect application of the model and includes the risk of under\-estimation or over\-estimation of risk. The models used by the Bank are being governed under Model Risk Management framework for model lifecycle. The model lifecycle involves working in all phases including development, validation, monitoring, issue identification, resolution, documentation, and governance.
